Hello! I am **Muhammad Hafizul Shah**.

I hold an M.Sc. in Physics with a focus on computational materials (DFT / CASTEP, HPC environments, and structural analysis). I am currently focused on advancing into **Data Science, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence**.

This website serves as my digital notebook, technical archive, and platform for exploring the intersection of physical principles, computational methods, and modern machine learning.
